steps.text: The game has two roots: the map seed, which builds acts, levels and rooms, and the game seed, which seeds the units.
calc: N = 12648430 (illustrative), an override of the seed.
map seed = N = 12648430; game seed = Init(N) = {00c0ffee:0000029a} (low:high).
Under an override the two start from the same number; they stay two separate seeds.
